concerns.text: FR-004 requires calculating “the Pearson or Spearman correlation coefficient” between `news_exposure_freq` and `anxiety_score` but does not pre‑specify which statistic will be used or the decision rule (e.g., normality test) for choosing between them. This leaves room for post‑hoc selection based on which yields a significant result, compromising the validity of the reported association.

SC-001 defines success as achieving p < 0.05 for the association but provides no pre‑registered effect‑size threshold, nor a plan for correcting for multiple comparisons (e.g., testing several covariates). Relying solely on a binary significance cut‑off without such safeguards can inflate Type I error.
